277	// ── bf16 <-> f32 bit codec (self-contained: the gate has no hip_bfloat16) ─────
278	// bf16 is the top 16 bits of an f32; operands flow to the MFMA wrappers as the
279	// raw `short` bit-pattern (matches amd::mfma_bf16_* which take const short[4]).
280	__device__ __forceinline__ float bf16_to_f32(short h) {
281	    unsigned u = static_cast<unsigned>(static_cast<unsigned short>(h)) << 16;
282	    return __builtin_bit_cast(float, u);
283	}
284	__device__ __forceinline__ short f32_to_bf16(float f) {
285	    unsigned u = __builtin_bit_cast(unsigned, f);
286	    unsigned lsb = (u >> 16) & 1u;
287	    u += 0x7fffu + lsb;
288	    return static_cast<short>(static_cast<unsigned short>(u >> 16));
289	}

292	// §A.0  Shared MFMA tile + driver for the adjoint matmuls.
293	//
294	// IDENTICAL operand contract to the §5 forward mfma_tile_16x16 /
295	// mfma_matmul_bf16: C[M,N] = A[M,K] · Wᵀ where W is [N,K] row-major (= Bᵀ
296	// already), contracting over K. The reverse pass simply feeds TRANSPOSED
297	// operands to realise the adjoint GEMMs:
298	//
299	//   forward  S[N,Lc]   = Q[N,D]  · Kᵀ           → A=Q[N,D],   W=K[Lc,D]
300	//   forward  O[N,D]    = P[N,Lc] · V            → A=P[N,Lc],  W=Vᵀ[D,Lc]
301	//   adjoint  dP[N,Lc]  = dO[N,D] · Vᵀ           → A=dO[N,D],  W=V[Lc,D]
302	//   adjoint  dV[Lc,D]  = Pᵀ[Lc,N] · dO          → A=Pᵀ[Lc,N], W=dOᵀ[D,N]
303	//   adjoint  dQ[N,D]   = dS[N,Lc] · K           → A=dS[N,Lc], W=Kᵀ[D,Lc]
304	//   adjoint  dKᵀ[Lc,D] = dSᵀ[Lc,N] · Q          → A=dSᵀ[Lc,N],W=Qᵀ[D,N]
305	//
306	// where in each case the second operand is supplied in the [out_cols, K]
307	// row-major layout the helper expects. Sub-16 K (grokking head_dim=4) is
308	// zero-padded inside the K loop, exactly like the forward.
309	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
310	__device__ __forceinline__ void mfma_tile_16x16(
311	    const short* __restrict__ A,   // [M, K] row-major bf16 bits
312	    const short* __restrict__ W,   // [N, K] row-major bf16 bits  (= Bᵀ)
313	    float*       __restrict__ C,   // [M, N] row-major f32
314	    int M, int N, int K,
315	    int tile_row, int tile_col)    // 16-aligned output-tile origin
316	{
317	    const int lane = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) % kWave;
318	    const int half = lane / 16;        // which 16-K group this lane feeds (0..3)
319	    const int idx  = lane % 16;        // row (A) / col (W) within the tile
320	
321	    float acc[4] = {0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.f};
322	
323	    const int aRow = tile_row + idx;   // A row this lane streams
324	    const int bCol = tile_col + idx;   // W row (= output col) this lane streams
325	
326	    for (int k0 = 0; k0 < K; k0 += 16) {
327	        short af[4], bf[4];
328	        #pragma unroll
329	        for (int j = 0; j < 4; ++j) {
330	            int k = k0 + half * 4 + j;   // 64 lanes cover the 16 K-values ×4
331	            af[j] = (aRow < M && k < K) ? amd::streaming_load(&A[aRow * K + k]) : (short)0;
332	            bf[j] = (bCol < N && k < K) ? amd::streaming_load(&W[bCol * K + k]) : (short)0;
333	        }
334	        amd::mfma_bf16_16x16x16(acc, af, bf);
335	        amd::sched_group_barrier<0x008, 1>();   // 1 MFMA …
336	        amd::sched_group_barrier<0x100, 2>();   // … then 2 VMEM reads
337	    }
338	
339	    #pragma unroll
340	    for (int r = 0; r < 4; ++r) {
341	        int outRow = tile_row + 4 * half + r;
342	        int outCol = tile_col + idx;
343	        if (outRow < M && outCol < N) C[outRow * N + outCol] = acc[r];
344	    }
345	}

347	// Whole-matrix driver: one wavefront strides the 16×16 output-tile lattice.
348	__device__ __forceinline__ void mfma_matmul_bf16(
349	    const short* __restrict__ A, const short* __restrict__ W,
350	    float* __restrict__ C, int M, int N, int K)
351	{
352	    const int tilesM = (M + 15) / 16;
353	    const int tilesN = (N + 15) / 16;
354	    const int nTiles = tilesM * tilesN;
355	    for (int t = 0; t < nTiles; ++t) {
356	        int tr = (t / tilesN) * 16;
357	        int tc = (t % tilesN) * 16;
358	        mfma_tile_16x16(A, W, C, M, N, K, tr, tc);
359	    }
360	}

374	// §A4  softmax-backward over a length-L row held by this wavefront (the joint
375	// attention axis [topk+wsz], or the PEER candidate axis). Given the forward
376	// softmax probs P[0,L) and the upstream grad dP[0,L) (both lane-strided in LDS),
377	// writes dS = P ⊙ (dP − Σ_j dP_j·P_j) back into dS_row. This is the exact
378	// softmax VJP the oracle uses (supergrok2_bilevel_adjoint.h:229-231):
379	//   dot = (dP*P).sum(-1);  dS = P*(dP - dot).
380	// The reduction is a DPP sum butterfly (§2.6); no LDS round-trip.
381	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
382	__device__ __forceinline__ void softmax_row_backward(
383	    const float* __restrict__ P,    // [L] forward softmax probs
384	    const float* __restrict__ dP,   // [L] upstream grad wrt probs
385	    float* __restrict__ dS,         // [L] out: grad wrt pre-softmax scores
386	    int L)
387	{
388	    const int lane = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) % kWave;
389	    float dot = 0.f;
390	    for (int j = lane; j < L; j += kWave) dot += dP[j] * P[j];
391	    dot = amd::wave_reduce_add_dpp(dot);          // §2.6 DPP sum butterfly
392	    for (int j = lane; j < L; j += kWave)
393	        dS[j] = P[j] * (dP[j] - dot);
394	}

397	// §A3  Attention-context backward — the CSA/HCA shared adjoint core.
398	//
399	// Mirrors hca_backward / csa_backward attention math (oracle 198-501) for ONE
400	// head/wavefront, single-head dense attention over the compressed entries
401	// (CSA: top-k selected, presented pre-gathered as cK/cV[Lc,D]; HCA: all
402	// compressed). Inputs: q[N,D], cK/cV[Lc,D] (bf16 bits), the saved forward probs
403	// P[N,Lc] (f32), and the upstream context grad d_ctx[N,D] (bf16 bits).
404	//
405	// Reverse pipeline (per head):
406	//   O = P·cV          ⇒  dP = d_ctx·cVᵀ          (MFMA: A=d_ctx[N,D], W=cV[Lc,D])
407	//                        dcV = Pᵀ·d_ctx           (MFMA: A=Pᵀ[Lc,N], W=d_ctxᵀ[D,N])
408	//   P = softmax(S)    ⇒  dS = P⊙(dP − Σ dP·P)     (§A4 DPP softmax-backward)
409	//   S = Q·cKᵀ·scale   ⇒  dQ  = (dS·scale)·cK      (MFMA: A=dS[N,Lc], W=cKᵀ? no →
410	//                                                   W=cK[Lc,D] is already [out,K])
411	//                        dcK = (dSᵀ·scale)·Q       (MFMA: A=dSᵀ[Lc,N], W=Qᵀ[D,N])
412	//
413	// Writes d_q[N,D], d_cK[Lc,D], d_cV[Lc,D] (bf16 bits). The downstream scatter of
414	// d_cK/d_cV back into token grads (compression / window / sel scatters) and the
415	// q/k/v-projection weight grads are the documented host (ATen oracle) tail.
416	//
417	// LDS scratch layout (caller-provided): dPf[N*Lc] f32, dSf[N*Lc] f32,
418	// d_ctxf[N*D] f32, accf[max(N*D, Lc*D)] f32, and a bf16 pack region
419	// pk[N*Lc + N*D + Lc*N + D*N + ...] — sized by sg2_attn_bwd_lds_bytes().
420	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
421	__device__ __forceinline__ void attention_ctx_backward_core(
422	    const short* __restrict__ q,      // [N, D] bf16 bits
423	    const short* __restrict__ cK,     // [Lc, D] bf16 bits (compressed keys)
424	    const short* __restrict__ cV,     // [Lc, D] bf16 bits (compressed values)
425	    const float* __restrict__ P,      // [N, Lc] forward softmax probs (f32)
426	    const short* __restrict__ d_ctx,  // [N, D] bf16 bits (upstream ctx grad)
427	    short* __restrict__ d_q,          // [N, D] bf16 bits (out)
428	    short* __restrict__ d_cK,         // [Lc, D] bf16 bits (out)
429	    short* __restrict__ d_cV,         // [Lc, D] bf16 bits (out)
430	    float* __restrict__ dPf,          // LDS: [N*Lc] f32
431	    float* __restrict__ dSf,          // LDS: [N*Lc] f32
432	    float* __restrict__ accf,         // LDS: [max(N*D, Lc*D)] f32
433	    short* __restrict__ Pbf,          // LDS: [N*Lc] bf16  (P / Pᵀ)
434	    short* __restrict__ Tbf,          // LDS: [max(Lc*N, D*N, Lc*D)] bf16 scratch
435	    int N, int Lc, int D, float scale)
436	{
437	    const int lane = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) % kWave;
438	
439	    // ── (1) dP = d_ctx · cVᵀ.  O[N,D]=P[N,Lc]·cV[Lc,D]; adjoint dP = dO·cVᵀ.
440	    //     mfma helper computes A·Wᵀ with W=[out_cols,K] row-major. Here out_cols
441	    //     = Lc, K = D, and W = cV[Lc,D] already (cV[j][d] contracts with d_ctx[i][d]).
442	    mfma_matmul_bf16(d_ctx, cV, dPf, N, Lc, D);
443	    amd::wait_vmcnt0();
444	
445	    // ── (2) softmax backward per row: dS = P ⊙ (dP − Σ dP·P).
446	    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
447	        softmax_row_backward(&P[i * Lc], &dPf[i * Lc], &dSf[i * Lc], Lc);
448	    // fold the attention scale (S = Q·cKᵀ·scale ⇒ dS *= scale) into dS.
449	    for (int idx = lane; idx < N * Lc; idx += kWave) dSf[idx] *= scale;
450	    amd::workgroup_barrier_release();
451	
452	    // ── (3) dQ = dS · cK.  S[N,Lc]=Q[N,D]·cKᵀ; adjoint dQ = dS·cK (contract Lc).
453	    //     mfma A·Wᵀ with A=dS[N,Lc], W=cKᵀ?  We need dQ[N,D]=Σ_j dS[i][j]·cK[j][d];
454	    //     that is A=dS[N,Lc] (K=Lc) and W=[out_cols=D, K=Lc] = cKᵀ[D,Lc]. Pack
455	    //     dS→bf16 and cK→cKᵀ in LDS, then MFMA.
456	    short* dSbf = Pbf;                          // reuse Pbf region: N*Lc shorts
457	    for (int idx = lane; idx < N * Lc; idx += kWave) dSbf[idx] = f32_to_bf16(dSf[idx]);
458	    short* cKt = Tbf;                            // D*Lc shorts (cKᵀ)
459	    for (int idx = lane; idx < Lc * D; idx += kWave) {
460	        int j = idx / D, d = idx % D;            // cK[j][d] → cKᵀ[d][j]
461	        cKt[d * Lc + j] = cK[idx];
462	    }
463	    amd::workgroup_barrier_release();
464	    mfma_matmul_bf16(dSbf, cKt, accf, N, D, Lc); // dQ[N,D]
465	    amd::wait_vmcnt0();
466	    for (int idx = lane; idx < N * D; idx += kWave) d_q[idx] = f32_to_bf16(accf[idx]);
467	    amd::workgroup_barrier_release();
468	
469	    // ── (4) dcK = dSᵀ · Q.  adjoint dcK[Lc,D]=Σ_i dS[i][j]·Q[i][d]; A=dSᵀ[Lc,N]
470	    //     (K=N), W=[out_cols=D, K=N]=Qᵀ[D,N]. Pack dSᵀ and Qᵀ to bf16 in LDS.
471	    short* dSt = Pbf;                            // Lc*N shorts (dSᵀ)
472	    for (int idx = lane; idx < N * Lc; idx += kWave) {
473	        int i = idx / Lc, j = idx % Lc;          // dS[i][j] → dSᵀ[j][i]
474	        dSt[j * N + i] = f32_to_bf16(dSf[idx]);
475	    }
476	    short* Qt = Tbf;                             // D*N shorts (Qᵀ)
477	    for (int idx = lane; idx < N * D; idx += kWave) {
478	        int i = idx / D, d = idx % D;            // Q[i][d] → Qᵀ[d][i]
479	        Qt[d * N + i] = q[idx];
480	    }
481	    amd::workgroup_barrier_release();
482	    mfma_matmul_bf16(dSt, Qt, accf, Lc, D, N);   // dcK[Lc,D]
483	    amd::wait_vmcnt0();
484	    for (int idx = lane; idx < Lc * D; idx += kWave) d_cK[idx] = f32_to_bf16(accf[idx]);
485	    amd::workgroup_barrier_release();
486	
487	    // ── (5) dcV = Pᵀ · d_ctx.  O=P·cV; adjoint dcV[Lc,D]=Σ_i P[i][j]·d_ctx[i][d];
488	    //     A=Pᵀ[Lc,N] (K=N), W=[out_cols=D, K=N]=d_ctxᵀ[D,N]. Pack both to bf16.
489	    short* Pt = Pbf;                             // Lc*N shorts (Pᵀ)
490	    for (int idx = lane; idx < N * Lc; idx += kWave) {
491	        int i = idx / Lc, j = idx % Lc;          // P[i][j] → Pᵀ[j][i]
492	        Pt[j * N + i] = f32_to_bf16(P[idx]);
493	    }
494	    short* dCt = Tbf;                            // D*N shorts (d_ctxᵀ)
495	    for (int idx = lane; idx < N * D; idx += kWave) {
496	        int i = idx / D, d = idx % D;            // d_ctx[i][d] → d_ctxᵀ[d][i]
497	        dCt[d * N + i] = d_ctx[idx];
498	    }
499	    amd::workgroup_barrier_release();
500	    mfma_matmul_bf16(Pt, dCt, accf, Lc, D, N);   // dcV[Lc,D]
501	    amd::wait_vmcnt0();
502	    for (int idx = lane; idx < Lc * D; idx += kWave) d_cV[idx] = f32_to_bf16(accf[idx]);
503	}

506	// §A2  GRU-gate backward (per element row, one wavefront).
507	//
508	// Mirrors bilevel_backward_driver GRU block (oracle 777-813). Forward:
509	//   z = σ(Wz·[x;h] + bz) ; r = σ(Wr·[x;h] + br) ;
510	//   h̃ = tanh(Wh·[x; r⊙h] + bh) ; h_new = (1−z)⊙h + z⊙h̃.
511	// Given d_h_new[hidden], the saved gates z,r,h̃[hidden], the input x[in_dim] and
512	// the carried h[hidden], accumulate the weight/bias grads (via AGENT atomics, as
513	// many element-rows share the weights) and write d_x[in_dim] / d_h_old[hidden].
514	//
515	// Adjoints (per hidden unit u):
516	//   d_z = d_h_new ⊙ (h̃ − h) ;  d_h̃ = d_h_new ⊙ z ;  d_h += d_h_new ⊙ (1−z)
517	//   d_preh = d_h̃ ⊙ (1 − h̃²) ;  d_pre_z = d_z ⊙ z ⊙ (1−z)
518	//   (Wh row dotted [x ; r⊙h]) ⇒ d_x += d_prehᵀ·Wh[:, :in] ; d_(r⊙h) = d_prehᵀ·Wh[:, in:]
519	//   d_r = d_(r⊙h) ⊙ h ;  d_h += d_(r⊙h) ⊙ r ;  d_pre_r = d_r ⊙ r ⊙ (1−r)
520	//   (Wz/Wr rows dotted [x ; h]) ⇒ d_x += d_pre_{z,r}ᵀ·W{z,r}[:, :in] ;
521	//                                  d_h += d_pre_{z,r}ᵀ·W{z,r}[:, in:]
522	//   dW{z,r,h}[u, j] += d_pre_*[u]·(row input)[j] ;  db{z,r,h}[u] += d_pre_*[u].
523	//
524	// Each lane owns a strided subset of hidden units. The d_x / d_h contributions
525	// require a cross-unit reduction over the [in_dim+hidden] concat columns, done
526	// with per-column AGENT atomics into the (zero-init) out buffers — element-local
527	// but correct. Weight/bias grads likewise go through AGENT atomics (§2.13).
528	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
529	__device__ __forceinline__ void gru_gate_backward_row(
530	    const float* __restrict__ x,        // [in_dim]
531	    const float* __restrict__ h,        // [hidden]  (carried h_old)
532	    const float* __restrict__ z,        // [hidden]  saved gate
533	    const float* __restrict__ r,        // [hidden]  saved gate
534	    const float* __restrict__ h_tilde,  // [hidden]  saved candidate
535	    const short* __restrict__ Wz,       // [hidden, in_dim+hidden] bf16 bits
536	    const short* __restrict__ Wr,
537	    const short* __restrict__ Wh,
538	    const float* __restrict__ d_h_new,  // [hidden]  upstream grad
539	    float* __restrict__ d_x,            // [in_dim]   out (atomic-accumulated)
540	    float* __restrict__ d_h_old,        // [hidden]   out (atomic-accumulated)
541	    float* __restrict__ d_Wz, float* __restrict__ d_Wr, float* __restrict__ d_Wh,
542	    float* __restrict__ d_bz, float* __restrict__ d_br, float* __restrict__ d_bh,
543	    int in_dim, int hidden)
544	{
545	    const int lane = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) % kWave;
546	    const int cat = in_dim + hidden;
547	
548	    for (int u = lane; u < hidden; u += kWave) {
549	        const float zu = z[u], ru = r[u], htu = h_tilde[u], hu = h[u];
550	        const float dnew = d_h_new[u];
551	
552	        // convex update adjoints
553	        float d_z      = dnew * (htu - hu);
554	        float d_htilde = dnew * zu;
555	        // d_h via (1-z)*h_old ; remaining d_h paths (r⊙h, [x;h] gate inputs)
556	        // accumulate below into d_h_old[u] atomically.
557	        amd::atomic_add_agent_f32(&d_h_old[u], dnew * (1.f - zu));
558	
559	        // tanh / sigmoid pre-activation grads
560	        float d_preh = d_htilde * (1.f - htu * htu);
561	        float d_prez = d_z * zu * (1.f - zu);
562	
563	        // bias grads
564	        amd::atomic_add_agent_f32(&d_bh[u], d_preh);
565	        amd::atomic_add_agent_f32(&d_bz[u], d_prez);
566	
567	        // h̃ row dotted [x ; r⊙h]: scatter dW and propagate to x / (r⊙h).
568	        float d_rh = 0.f;  // grad wrt (r⊙h)[u]'s contribution gathered per-col below
569	        // Wh column loop — input part (x) and hidden part (r⊙h).
570	        for (int j = 0; j < in_dim; ++j) {
571	            float wij = bf16_to_f32(Wh[u * cat + j]);
572	            amd::atomic_add_agent_f32(&d_Wh[u * cat + j], d_preh * x[j]);
573	            amd::atomic_add_agent_f32(&d_x[j], d_preh * wij);
574	        }
575	        for (int j = 0; j < hidden; ++j) {
576	            float wij = bf16_to_f32(Wh[u * cat + in_dim + j]);
577	            float rh_j = r[j] * h[j];               // (r⊙h)[j]
578	            amd::atomic_add_agent_f32(&d_Wh[u * cat + in_dim + j], d_preh * rh_j);
579	            // d(r⊙h)[j] += d_preh * wij ; split into d_r[j], d_h[j] at unit j.
580	            float drh = d_preh * wij;
581	            // d_r[j] = drh*h[j] → through r=σ(...) → d_pre_r[j]; fold into Wr/x/h
582	            // here using j's own r,h. (Each (u,j) pair contributes; correctness
583	            // relies on AGENT-atomic accumulation across u.)
584	            float d_r_j   = drh * h[j];
585	            float d_pre_r = d_r_j * r[j] * (1.f - r[j]);
586	            amd::atomic_add_agent_f32(&d_h_old[j], drh * r[j]);  // d_h via r⊙h
587	            amd::atomic_add_agent_f32(&d_br[j], d_pre_r);
588	            // Wr row j dotted [x ; h]
589	            for (int q2 = 0; q2 < in_dim; ++q2) {
590	                float wrj = bf16_to_f32(Wr[j * cat + q2]);
591	                amd::atomic_add_agent_f32(&d_Wr[j * cat + q2], d_pre_r * x[q2]);
592	                amd::atomic_add_agent_f32(&d_x[q2], d_pre_r * wrj);
593	            }
594	            for (int q2 = 0; q2 < hidden; ++q2) {
595	                float wrj = bf16_to_f32(Wr[j * cat + in_dim + q2]);
596	                amd::atomic_add_agent_f32(&d_Wr[j * cat + in_dim + q2], d_pre_r * h[q2]);
597	                amd::atomic_add_agent_f32(&d_h_old[q2], d_pre_r * wrj);
598	            }
599	        }
600	        (void)d_rh;
601	
602	        // z row dotted [x ; h]: scatter dWz and propagate to x / h.
603	        for (int j = 0; j < in_dim; ++j) {
604	            float wij = bf16_to_f32(Wz[u * cat + j]);
605	            amd::atomic_add_agent_f32(&d_Wz[u * cat + j], d_prez * x[j]);
606	            amd::atomic_add_agent_f32(&d_x[j], d_prez * wij);
607	        }
608	        for (int j = 0; j < hidden; ++j) {
609	            float wij = bf16_to_f32(Wz[u * cat + in_dim + j]);
610	            amd::atomic_add_agent_f32(&d_Wz[u * cat + in_dim + j], d_prez * h[j]);
611	            amd::atomic_add_agent_f32(&d_h_old[j], d_prez * wij);
612	        }
613	    }
614	}
615	
616	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
617	// §A1  PEER expert-MLP backward (one wavefront per token row, single head).
618	//
619	// Mirrors sg2_bilevel::peer_head_backward (oracle 610-707) for the inline-expert
620	// path the §5 forward peer_route_row uses (scalar expert input = a_val+b_val,
621	// hidden = relu(W1·inp), out = Σ W2·hidden). Forward (recomputed here):
622	//   per-half top-k over num_keys → soft = softmax(top_vals*T) (T=10) →
623	//   candidate grid (expert = a_idx*num_keys+b_idx, routing_w = soft_a⊗soft_b) →
624	//   out_c = Σ_h W2[e,h]·relu(W1[e,h]·inp_c) ; head_out = Σ_c routing_w_c·out_c.
625	//
626	// Given d_head_out (scalar for this row/head), accumulate the expert weight
627	// grads (d_W1/d_W2 via AGENT atomics on the shared expert tables, §2.13) and the
628	// product-key grads d_A/d_B. The grad wrt peer_input flows through the query
629	// projection and is the documented host tail (d_Wq, d_peer_input = d_query·Wq);
630	// here we emit the expert + product-key adjoints (the MFMA/DPP-justified work).
631	//
632	// NOTE (stop-grad top-k): the discrete top-k INDEX sets are routing decisions
633	// with no grad (oracle 275-279). Grads flow through the gathered values: the
634	// softmax-of-top-vals path (→ d_top_vals → scatter into d_scores → d_q_a/d_q_b →
635	// d_A/d_B) and the expert-value path (→ d_W1/d_W2). Identical to the oracle.
636	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
637	template <int kTopK>
638	__device__ __forceinline__ void peer_route_backward_row(
639	    const float* __restrict__ q_a,    // [half_qd]
640	    const float* __restrict__ q_b,    // [half_qd]
641	    const short* __restrict__ keys_a, // [num_keys, half_qd] bf16 bits
642	    const short* __restrict__ keys_b, // [num_keys, half_qd] bf16 bits
643	    const short* __restrict__ expert_W1,  // [num_experts, expert_hidden] bf16 bits
644	    const short* __restrict__ expert_W2,  // [num_experts, expert_hidden] bf16 bits
645	    float d_head_out,
646	    float* __restrict__ d_A,          // [num_keys, half_qd]  out (atomic)
647	    float* __restrict__ d_B,          // [num_keys, half_qd]  out (atomic)
648	    float* __restrict__ d_expert_W1,  // [num_experts, expert_hidden] out (atomic)
649	    float* __restrict__ d_expert_W2,  // [num_experts, expert_hidden] out (atomic)
650	    int num_keys, int half_qd, int expert_hidden)
651	{
652	    const int lane = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) % kWave;
653	    const float T = 10.f;
654	
655	    // ── recompute per-half top-k (lane-0 owns the small scan; broadcast) ──
656	    float a_val[kTopK]; int a_idx[kTopK];
657	    float b_val[kTopK]; int b_idx[kTopK];
658	    #pragma unroll
659	    for (int t = 0; t < kTopK; ++t) { a_val[t]=-1e30f; a_idx[t]=0; b_val[t]=-1e30f; b_idx[t]=0; }
660	    for (int t = 0; t < kTopK; ++t) {
661	        float best=-1e30f; int besti=0;
662	        for (int kk = 0; kk < num_keys; ++kk) {
663	            bool taken=false;
664	            for (int u=0;u<t;++u) if (a_idx[u]==kk) taken=true;
665	            if (taken) continue;
666	            float s=0.f;
667	            for (int d=0; d<half_qd; ++d) s += q_a[d]*bf16_to_f32(keys_a[kk*half_qd+d]);
668	            if (s>best){best=s;besti=kk;}
669	        }
670	        a_val[t]=best; a_idx[t]=besti;
671	        best=-1e30f; besti=0;
672	        for (int kk = 0; kk < num_keys; ++kk) {
673	            bool taken=false;
674	            for (int u=0;u<t;++u) if (b_idx[u]==kk) taken=true;
675	            if (taken) continue;
676	            float s=0.f;
677	            for (int d=0; d<half_qd; ++d) s += q_b[d]*bf16_to_f32(keys_b[kk*half_qd+d]);
678	            if (s>best){best=s;besti=kk;}
679	        }
680	        b_val[t]=best; b_idx[t]=besti;
681	    }
682	
683	    // ── soft = softmax(top_vals*T) ──
684	    const int kk2 = kTopK * kTopK;
685	    float pmax=-1e30f;
686	    for (int t=0;t<kTopK;++t){ pmax=dfmaxf(pmax,a_val[t]); }   // for soft_a stability
687	    float amax=-1e30f, bmax=-1e30f;
688	    for (int t=0;t<kTopK;++t){ amax=dfmaxf(amax,a_val[t]); bmax=dfmaxf(bmax,b_val[t]); }
689	    float asum=0.f,bsum=0.f, soft_a[kTopK], soft_b[kTopK];
690	    for (int t=0;t<kTopK;++t){ soft_a[t]=dexpf((a_val[t]-amax)*T); asum+=soft_a[t]; }
691	    for (int t=0;t<kTopK;++t){ soft_b[t]=dexpf((b_val[t]-bmax)*T); bsum+=soft_b[t]; }
692	    float ainv=1.f/dfmaxf(asum,1e-12f), binv=1.f/dfmaxf(bsum,1e-12f);
693	    for (int t=0;t<kTopK;++t){ soft_a[t]*=ainv; soft_b[t]*=binv; }
694	    (void)pmax;
695	
696	    // ── recompute out_c and the expert-value adjoint; accumulate d_routing ──
697	    // out_c = Σ_h W2[e,h]·relu(W1[e,h]·inp_c), inp_c = a_val[i]+b_val[j].
698	    // head_out = Σ_c routing_w_c·out_c ;  d_routing_w_c = d_head_out·out_c ;
699	    // d_out_c = d_head_out·routing_w_c.
700	    float d_soft_a[kTopK], d_soft_b[kTopK];
701	    #pragma unroll
702	    for (int t=0;t<kTopK;++t){ d_soft_a[t]=0.f; d_soft_b[t]=0.f; }
703	
704	    for (int c=0;c<kk2;++c) {
705	        int i=c/kTopK, j=c%kTopK;
706	        int e = a_idx[i]*num_keys + b_idx[j];
707	        float inp = a_val[i] + b_val[j];
708	        float rw  = soft_a[i]*soft_b[j];
709	
710	        // out_c via lane-cooperative reduction over expert_hidden.
711	        float out=0.f;
712	        for (int h=lane; h<expert_hidden; h+=kWave) {
713	            float w1=bf16_to_f32(expert_W1[e*expert_hidden+h]);
714	            float w2=bf16_to_f32(expert_W2[e*expert_hidden+h]);
715	            out += w2 * (w1*inp > 0.f ? w1*inp : 0.f);
716	        }
717	        out = amd::wave_reduce_add_dpp(out);     // §2.6 every lane gets out_c
718	
719	        float d_out = d_head_out * rw;           // d wrt out_c
720	        d_soft_a[i] += d_head_out * out * soft_b[j];   // d_routing → d_soft_a
721	        d_soft_b[j] += d_head_out * out * soft_a[i];
722	
723	        // expert-weight adjoints (lane-strided; AGENT-atomic into shared tables):
724	        //   z_h = relu(W1[e,h]·inp) ; out = Σ_h W2[e,h]·z_h.
725	        //   d_W2[e,h] += d_out·z_h ; d_z_h = d_out·W2[e,h] ;
726	        //   d_pre_h = d_z_h·[W1·inp>0] ; d_W1[e,h] += d_pre_h·inp.
727	        for (int h=lane; h<expert_hidden; h+=kWave) {
728	            float w1=bf16_to_f32(expert_W1[e*expert_hidden+h]);
729	            float w2=bf16_to_f32(expert_W2[e*expert_hidden+h]);
730	            float pre = w1*inp;
731	            float z_h = pre > 0.f ? pre : 0.f;
732	            amd::atomic_add_agent_f32(&d_expert_W2[e*expert_hidden+h], d_out * z_h);
733	            float d_z   = d_out * w2;
734	            float d_pre = pre > 0.f ? d_z : 0.f;
735	            amd::atomic_add_agent_f32(&d_expert_W1[e*expert_hidden+h], d_pre * inp);
736	        }
737	    }
738	
739	    // ── soft = softmax(vals*T) backward → d_top_vals ──
740	    float sa_dot=0.f, sb_dot=0.f;
741	    for (int t=0;t<kTopK;++t){ sa_dot+=d_soft_a[t]*soft_a[t]; sb_dot+=d_soft_b[t]*soft_b[t]; }
742	    float d_top_a[kTopK], d_top_b[kTopK];
743	    for (int t=0;t<kTopK;++t){
744	        d_top_a[t] = soft_a[t]*(d_soft_a[t]-sa_dot)*T;
745	        d_top_b[t] = soft_b[t]*(d_soft_b[t]-sb_dot)*T;
746	    }
747	
748	    // ── top_vals = q_half · keys[idx] → d_keys (and d_q_half, host tail). ──
749	    // scores_a[idx] = Σ_d q_a[d]·keys_a[idx][d]; only selected idx get grad.
750	    // d_A[a_idx[t], d] += d_top_a[t]·q_a[d]   (lane-strided over half_qd).
751	    for (int t=0;t<kTopK;++t) {
752	        int ia=a_idx[t], ib=b_idx[t];
753	        for (int d=lane; d<half_qd; d+=kWave) {
754	            amd::atomic_add_agent_f32(&d_A[ia*half_qd+d], d_top_a[t]*q_a[d]);
755	            amd::atomic_add_agent_f32(&d_B[ib*half_qd+d], d_top_b[t]*q_b[d]);
756	        }
757	    }
758	}
759	
760	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
761	// §A.LAUNCH  __global__ entry kernels (host launches via hipLaunchKernelGGL from
762	// the ATen orchestration in the host TU; see the §A.LAUNCH note in pass A). bf16
763	// activations flow as raw `short` bit-patterns.
764	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
765	
766	// LDS byte budget for one attention-context backward head.
767	//   dPf[N*Lc]+dSf[N*Lc]+accf[max(N*D,Lc*D)] f32  +  Pbf[max(N*Lc,Lc*N)]+
768	//   Tbf[max(Lc*N,D*N,Lc*D)] bf16.
769	__device__ __forceinline__ int sg2_attn_bwd_lds_bytes(int N, int Lc, int D) {
770	    int accf = (N * D > Lc * D) ? N * D : Lc * D;
771	    int f32b = (N * Lc + N * Lc + accf) * (int)sizeof(float);
772	    int pbf  = (N * Lc);                       // Pbf region (also holds Lc*N == N*Lc)
773	    int tmax = Lc * N; if (D * N > tmax) tmax = D * N; if (Lc * D > tmax) tmax = Lc * D;
774	    int bf16b = (pbf + tmax) * (int)sizeof(short);
775	    return f32b + bf16b;
776	}
777	
778	// Attention-context backward: one wavefront per head. cK/cV are the already-
779	// gathered compressed entries [Lc,D] for this head (CSA top-k∪window or HCA all-
780	// compressed); P[N,Lc] are the saved forward probs for this head.
781	template <int kHeadDimT>
782	__global__ void sg2_attn_ctx_bwd_kernel(
783	    const short* __restrict__ q,      // [N, D]
784	    const short* __restrict__ cK,     // [Lc, D]
785	    const short* __restrict__ cV,     // [Lc, D]
786	    const float* __restrict__ P,      // [N, Lc]
787	    const short* __restrict__ d_ctx,  // [N, D]
788	    short* __restrict__ d_q,          // [N, D]
789	    short* __restrict__ d_cK,         // [Lc, D]
790	    short* __restrict__ d_cV,         // [Lc, D]
791	    int N, int Lc, float scale)
792	{
793	    extern __shared__ float lds[];
794	    const int D = kHeadDimT;
795	    int accf_n = (N * D > Lc * D) ? N * D : Lc * D;
796	    float* dPf = lds;                          // N*Lc f32
797	    float* dSf = dPf + N * Lc;                 // N*Lc f32
798	    float* accf = dSf + N * Lc;                // accf_n f32
799	    short* Pbf  = reinterpret_cast<short*>(accf + accf_n);  // N*Lc shorts
800	    int tmax = Lc * N; if (D * N > tmax) tmax = D * N; if (Lc * D > tmax) tmax = Lc * D;
801	    short* Tbf  = Pbf + N * Lc;                 // tmax shorts
802	    (void)tmax;
803	    attention_ctx_backward_core(q, cK, cV, P, d_ctx, d_q, d_cK, d_cV,
804	                                dPf, dSf, accf, Pbf, Tbf, N, Lc, D, scale);
805	}
806	
807	// GRU-gate backward: one wavefront per element row. Out grads are AGENT-atomic
808	// accumulated (zero-init by the caller).
809	__global__ void sg2_gru_gate_bwd_kernel(
810	    const float* __restrict__ x,        // [N, in_dim]
811	    const float* __restrict__ h,        // [N, hidden]
812	    const float* __restrict__ z,        // [N, hidden]
813	    const float* __restrict__ r,        // [N, hidden]
814	    const float* __restrict__ h_tilde,  // [N, hidden]
815	    const short* __restrict__ Wz, const short* __restrict__ Wr,
816	    const short* __restrict__ Wh,
817	    const float* __restrict__ d_h_new,  // [N, hidden]
818	    float* __restrict__ d_x,            // [N, in_dim]   (or shared; atomic)
819	    float* __restrict__ d_h_old,        // [N, hidden]   (or shared; atomic)
820	    float* __restrict__ d_Wz, float* __restrict__ d_Wr, float* __restrict__ d_Wh,
821	    float* __restrict__ d_bz, float* __restrict__ d_br, float* __restrict__ d_bh,
822	    int in_dim, int hidden)
823	{
824	    const int row = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x);
825	    gru_gate_backward_row(
826	        x + row * in_dim, h + row * hidden, z + row * hidden, r + row * hidden,
827	        h_tilde + row * hidden, Wz, Wr, Wh, d_h_new + row * hidden,
828	        d_x + row * in_dim, d_h_old + row * hidden,
829	        d_Wz, d_Wr, d_Wh, d_bz, d_br, d_bh, in_dim, hidden);
830	}
831	
832	// PEER expert-MLP backward: one wavefront per token row, single head (host loops
833	// heads). q_a/q_b are the pre-split projected query halves for this row.
834	__global__ void sg2_peer_route_bwd_kernel(
835	    const float* __restrict__ q_a, const float* __restrict__ q_b,
836	    const short* __restrict__ keys_a, const short* __restrict__ keys_b,
837	    const short* __restrict__ expert_W1, const short* __restrict__ expert_W2,
838	    const float* __restrict__ d_head_out,  // [N]
839	    float* __restrict__ d_A, float* __restrict__ d_B,
840	    float* __restrict__ d_expert_W1, float* __restrict__ d_expert_W2,
841	    int num_keys, int half_qd, int expert_hidden)
842	{
843	    const int row = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x);
844	    peer_route_backward_row<4>(
845	        q_a + row * half_qd, q_b + row * half_qd,
846	        keys_a, keys_b, expert_W1, expert_W2,
847	        d_head_out[row], d_A, d_B, d_expert_W1, d_expert_W2,
848	        num_keys, half_qd, expert_hidden);
849	}
